points.S1: 强光、紫外、红外光源的防护
points.S2: 灯具高温：防烫、远离易燃物
points.S4: 灯管破碎：汞与玻璃碎片
points.S5: 眼睛受照后：报告与就医

shots.scene: 欣欣站在光学实验台旁，台上摆着灯泡、灯管和小 LED，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an optical table with a light bulb, a fluorescent tube and a small LED on it, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲光源，还有光怎样伤害人体。
overlay: 光源与光对人体的作用

shots.scene: 灯泡、眼睛、皮肤三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a glowing light bulb, a human eye and a patch of skin. No people.
shots.narration: 先认识光源，再认识眼睛和皮肤。

shots.scene: 阿杰刚关掉一盏卤素灯，伸手要去拧灯泡
shots.prompt_en: In an optics lab, the young male student has just switched off a halogen work lamp and reaches out with his bare hand to unscrew the bulb.
shots.narration: 阿杰刚关灯，就想徒手去换灯泡。

shots.scene: 小研拉住他，指向旁边一盏亮着的紫外灯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds back the young male student and points at a glowing ultraviolet lamp on the bench nearby.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：灯还烫，那边紫外灯也亮着。

shots.scene: 徒手抓热灯泡、直视亮灯两个图标，各打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a bare hand grabbing a hot bulb, and an eye staring at a bright lamp, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 烫手、伤眼，都是光源带来的风险。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先弄懂光源怎么发光，才知道怎么防。

shots.scene: 太阳和电灯两个图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a sun and an electric light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 光源分两类：自然光源和人造光源。

shots.scene: 人造光源分叉成灯泡和激光器两个图标
shots.prompt_en: A branching diagram: a light bulb icon on one branch and a small laser box with a beam on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 人造光源又分非激光光源和激光。

shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot taps a large light bulb icon on a blank board.
shots.narration: 这一课只讲非激光光源。

shots.scene: 五个图标排成一排：灯泡、灯管、大放电灯、闪光灯管、LED
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a light bulb, a long fluorescent tube, a large discharge lamp, a straight flash tube and a small LED. No people.
shots.narration: 常见的非激光光源有五类。

shots.scene: 小研在空白笔记本上逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ticks five items on a blank notebook page at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 白炽、荧光、放电、闪光，还有LED。

shots.scene: 灯泡剖面示意：玻壳里一根发光的灯丝
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway illustration of a light bulb with a glowing coiled filament inside a glass bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 白炽灯靠灯丝烧得通红来发光。

shots.scene: 温度计、坚固的链条、不冒烟的金属丝三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a tall thermometer, a strong chain link, and a metal wire with no vapor rising from it. No people.
shots.narration: 钨耐高温、不易蒸发，还很结实。

shots.scene: 灯泡里飘着浅色气体小点
shots.prompt_en: A light bulb illustration filled with small pale gas dots around the filament. No people.
shots.narration: 灯泡里充惰性气体，让灯丝更长寿。

shots.scene: 旧灯泡内壁发黑的示意图
shots.prompt_en: An illustration of an old light bulb with a dark gray coating on the inside of the glass. No people.
shots.narration: 灯丝的钨会蒸发，粘在玻壳上发黑。

shots.scene: 小卫士图标把钨小颗粒送回灯丝
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon illustration of tiny helper dots carrying small metal particles back from the glass wall to the filament. No people.
shots.narration: 加一点卤素，把钨“送回”灯丝。

shots.scene: 干净透亮的卤素灯泡
shots.prompt_en: A clean, clear small halogen bulb glowing brightly. No people.
shots.narration: 这样灯泡就能一直保持透亮。

shots.scene: 卤素灯泡旁冒出热浪线
shots.prompt_en: A glowing small halogen bulb with wavy heat lines rising from it. No people.
shots.narration: 卤素灯必须很热，循环才转得起来。

shots.scene: 石英灯壳与普通玻璃对比，普通玻璃上有裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Two small bulbs side by side: a quartz bulb intact and an ordinary glass bulb with crack lines. No people.
shots.narration: 普通玻璃受不了，要用石英或耐热玻璃。

shots.scene: 欣欣把手缩回，指向热灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pulls its paw back from a glowing bulb and points at the heat lines.
shots.narration: 记住：白炽类的灯都很烫。

shots.scene: 直灯丝和螺旋灯丝两个线图
shots.prompt_en: Two simple line drawings: a straight filament and a coiled filament between two support wires. No people.
shots.narration: 灯丝可以是直的，也可以绕成螺旋。

shots.scene: 一根长绳绕成弹簧的比喻图
shots.prompt_en: An illustration of a long rope being wound into a compact spring shape. No people.
shots.narration: 绕成螺旋，就能把更长的丝装进去。

shots.scene: 密绕螺旋发出均匀亮光，疏绕螺旋光较暗
shots.prompt_en: Two coils side by side: a tightly wound coil glowing evenly and brightly, and a loosely wound coil glowing dimmer. No people.
shots.narration: 绕得密更亮更匀，绕得疏更便宜。

shots.scene: 一台老式幻灯投影机图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an old slide projector casting a blank square of light. No people.
shots.narration: 不需要强光的投影，用疏绕就够了。

shots.scene: 一根荧光灯管的剖面示意
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway illustration of a fluorescent tube with a white coating on the inside of the glass. No people.
shots.narration: 荧光灯是低压汞蒸气放电灯。

shots.scene: 电子撞击汞原子，冒出紫色小光点
shots.prompt_en: An illustration of electrons flowing through the tube and hitting small atoms, which give off violet sparkles. No people.
shots.narration: 通电后电子撞汞原子，放出紫外线。

shots.scene: 紫色光点打到内壁涂层，变成白光射出
shots.prompt_en: Violet sparkles strike the white inner coating of the tube and turn into bright white light shining outward. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外线打到荧光粉上，变成可见光。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一盏亮白的荧光灯管
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a glowing white fluorescent tube.
shots.narration: 像接力赛：电子传给汞，汞传给荧光粉。

shots.scene: 灯管两端的电极，一端暖色一端冷色
shots.prompt_en: A fluorescent tube with an electrode at each end, one glowing warm orange and one pale blue. No people.
shots.narration: 电极分冷阴极和热阴极。

shots.scene: 冷阴极旁画快进图标，热阴极旁画灯泡加号
shots.prompt_en: A fast-forward icon beside the pale blue electrode and a brighter bulb icon with a plus sign beside the orange electrode. No people.
shots.narration: 冷阴极启动快，热阴极更省电。

shots.scene: 电能进、可见光出的漏斗比喻图
shots.prompt_en: A funnel diagram: a lightning bolt icon goes in at the top and a bundle of light rays comes out at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 光效：多少电能变成了看得见的光。

shots.scene: 一长一短两根灯管，长的更亮
shots.prompt_en: Two fluorescent tubes, one long and one short, the long one glowing brighter. No people.
shots.narration: 一般来说，灯管越长，光效越高。

shots.scene: 灯管连着一个空白小盒子
shots.prompt_en: A fluorescent tube connected by wires to a small blank box. No people.
shots.narration: 荧光灯离不开镇流器。

shots.scene: 两个空白盒子，各连一根灯管
shots.prompt_en: Two blank boxes of different shapes, each connected to a glowing tube. No people.
shots.narration: 常见快速启动型和预热型两种。

shots.scene: 亮度条和沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: A brightness bar icon and an hourglass icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 镇流器选得对，灯更亮、寿命更长。

shots.scene: 一盏大号放电灯泡，中间小管里有一道亮弧
shots.prompt_en: A large discharge lamp bulb with a small inner arc tube in the middle showing a bright arc between two electrodes. No people.
shots.narration: 高强度放电灯靠电弧发光。

shots.scene: 小管里气体点火，金属盐变成发亮的等离子云
shots.prompt_en: Inside a small arc tube, a spark starts and then small salt grains turn into a glowing plasma cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 气体先起弧，金属盐受热变成等离子。

shots.scene: 电弧管图标旁有汞、钠、金属卤化物三个小瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A small arc tube icon next to three blank small vial icons. No people.
shots.narration: 有汞灯、钠灯和金属卤化物灯。

shots.scene: 电弧管外有压力表图标
shots.prompt_en: An arc tube icon with a pressure gauge icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 管里有好几个大气压，所以叫高压灯。

shots.section_title: 放电灯外壳破了会漏紫外
shots.scene: 放电灯的内管和外壳两层示意
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway illustration of a discharge lamp showing an inner quartz tube and an outer glass jacket. No people.
shots.narration: 含汞放电灯有两层玻壳。
overlay: 放电灯外壳破了会漏紫外

shots.section_title: 放电灯外壳破了会漏紫外
shots.scene: 外壳像一件外套，把紫色射线挡在里面
shots.prompt_en: The outer glass jacket is drawn like a coat, keeping violet rays inside. No people.
shots.narration: 外壳的任务，是把紫外线挡在里面。

shots.section_title: 放电灯外壳破了会漏紫外
shots.scene: 外壳被飞来的碎片打破，紫色射线漏出
shots.prompt_en: A small flying fragment cracks the outer jacket and violet rays leak out through the hole. No people.
shots.narration: 外壳破了，灯却还亮，紫外就漏出来。

shots.section_title: 放电灯外壳破了会漏紫外
shots.scene: 眼睛发红和皮肤发红两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a red irritated eye and a reddened patch of skin with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 会灼伤皮肤，引起眼睛发炎。

shots.section_title: 放电灯外壳破了会漏紫外
shots.scene: 外壳破损后灯自动熄灭的示意
shots.prompt_en: A lamp with a cracked outer jacket that has gone dark, with a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 可选外壳一破就自动熄灭的灯。

shots.section_title: 放电灯外壳破了会漏紫外
shots.scene: 老李关掉电闸，给破灯挂上空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off a wall breaker and hangs a blank out-of-service tag on a lamp with a cracked jacket.
shots.narration: 发现外壳破损，立即断电停用。

shots.scene: 一根直的闪光灯管，两端是电极
shots.prompt_en: A straight flash tube with an electrode at each end, flashing brightly. No people.
shots.narration: 闪光灯和弧光灯也是放电灯。

shots.scene: 照相机闪光和激光器里的闪光灯图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a camera with a flash and a laser box with a flash tube inside. No people.
shots.narration: 用在摄影和激光器里。

shots.scene: 闪光灯管两端闪电图标，管内气体被点亮
shots.prompt_en: A flash tube with lightning bolt icons at both ends and the gas inside lit up. No people.
shots.narration: 管里充氙或氪，靠高压触发放电。

shots.scene: 灯管外包着一层流水的套管
shots.prompt_en: A flash tube surrounded by an outer sleeve with flowing water arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 发光强、发热大，常用水套冷却。

shots.scene: 一颗小小的 LED 发出红光
shots.prompt_en: A small LED glowing red on a blank circuit board. No people.
shots.narration: 发光二极管，就是LED。

shots.scene: 光纤、计算器、显示屏三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a fiber optic cable, a pocket calculator with a blank screen, and a blank display panel. No people.
shots.narration: 通信、计算器、显示屏都用它。

shots.scene: 两颗 LED，一颗发可见光，一颗发看不见的暗红光
shots.prompt_en: Two LEDs: one glowing green and one with faint dark red rays marked by an invisible-light icon. No people.
shots.narration: LED能发可见光，也能发红外光。

shots.section_title: LED 与激光二极管的区别
shots.scene: LED 向四面八方发光，激光二极管射出一条细光束
shots.prompt_en: Side by side: an LED glowing in all directions, and a laser diode emitting one narrow straight beam. No people.
shots.narration: LED向四面散光，激光管射出细光束。
overlay: LED 与激光二极管的区别

shots.section_title: LED 与激光二极管的区别
shots.scene: 一群人各走各路 vs 一队人齐步走的比喻图
shots.prompt_en: A metaphor illustration: a crowd of dots walking in random directions next to a neat column of dots marching in step. No people.
shots.narration: 一个各自发光，一个整齐受激发光。

shots.section_title: LED 与激光二极管的区别
shots.scene: 小、凉、结实、便宜四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a tiny size ruler, a snowflake, a shield and a coin. No people.
shots.narration: LED功率小，但小巧、低温、耐用。

shots.section_title: LED 与激光二极管的区别
shots.scene: LED 灯泡和白炽灯泡并排，LED 旁有省电图标
shots.prompt_en: An LED household bulb and an incandescent bulb side by side, with an energy-saving leaf icon by the LED. No people.
shots.narration: LED灯泡比白炽灯省电得多。

shots.scene: 两块拼在一起的方块，一边满是小点，一边满是小圆圈
shots.prompt_en: Two blocks joined together: one filled with small dots, the other filled with small empty circles, with a thin gap between. No people.
shots.narration: PN结：一边电子多，一边空穴多。

shots.scene: 中间的缝像一道门槛
shots.prompt_en: The thin gap between the two blocks is drawn as a low threshold barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 中间有一道门槛，挡住电流。

shots.scene: 正向接电时门槛变低，小点流过去
shots.prompt_en: With a battery icon connected one way, the barrier shrinks and dots flow across. No people.
shots.narration: 正着接，门槛变低，电流通过。

shots.scene: 反向接电时门槛变高，被挡住
shots.prompt_en: With the battery icon reversed, the barrier grows taller and the dots are blocked. No people.
shots.narration: 反着接，门槛变高，电流被挡。

shots.scene: 小点从高台阶跳到低台阶，掉进小圆圈，冒出一颗光点
shots.prompt_en: A dot jumps down from a high step to a low step, drops into an empty circle and releases a small spark of light. No people.
shots.narration: 电子从高处落进空穴，多余能量变成光。

shots.scene: 许多光点汇成 LED 的亮光
shots.prompt_en: Many small sparks join together into the steady glow of an LED. No people.
shots.narration: 无数次这样的“落下”，就是LED的光。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一颗发光的 LED
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a glowing LED carefully in its paws.
shots.narration: 能量守恒，在LED里看得见。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一个大眼睛模型
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a large model of a human eye on a stand.
shots.narration: 要懂光的危害，先认识眼睛。

shots.scene: 眼球剖面示意：前面透明，后面一层感光膜
shots.prompt_en: A simple cross-section illustration of an eyeball with a clear front window, a lens and a light-sensitive layer at the back. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睛是能接收、聚焦、感光的仪器。

shots.scene: 眼球外层白色，内部充满透明液体和凝胶
shots.prompt_en: The eyeball illustration with its white outer layer highlighted and clear fluid and gel inside. No people.
shots.narration: 白色外壳和眼内液体，撑起眼球形状。

shots.scene: 光线穿过角膜和晶状体，落到眼底
shots.prompt_en: Light rays pass through the clear front window and the lens and land on the back of the eye. No people.
shots.narration: 光穿过角膜、晶状体，落到视网膜。

shots.section_title: 聚焦放大：杂散光束最伤眼
shots.scene: 放大镜把阳光聚成一个亮点的比喻图
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass focusing sunlight into one tiny bright dot on a leaf. No people.
shots.narration: 晶状体像放大镜，把光聚成一点。
overlay: 聚焦放大：杂散光束最伤眼

shots.section_title: 聚焦放大：杂散光束最伤眼
shots.scene: 宽光束进眼，眼底一个刺眼的小点
shots.prompt_en: A wide beam enters the eye illustration and becomes a tiny, intensely bright dot on the back of the eye. No people.
shots.narration: 同样的光，聚到眼底强了许多许多倍。

shots.section_title: 聚焦放大：杂散光束最伤眼
shots.scene: 一道细光束从镜子反射，射向眼睛图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A thin beam bounces off a small mirror toward an eye icon, with a red X on the path. No people.
shots.narration: 所以杂散的激光束射进眼里，最危险。

shots.section_title: 聚焦放大：杂散光束最伤眼
shots.scene: 视神经把信号传到大脑的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple illustration of signals traveling from the back of the eye along a nerve to a brain icon. No people.
shots.narration: 视网膜的信号经视神经送到大脑。

shots.scene: 眼球最前面透明的一层被高亮
shots.prompt_en: The eyeball illustration with the clear front layer highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 角膜是眼睛最外面的透明窗口。

shots.scene: 角膜图标旁有循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A cornea icon with a circular renewal arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 角膜细胞更新快，轻伤好得快。

shots.scene: 角膜和晶状体之间的水样液体，吸走热浪
shots.prompt_en: Clear watery fluid between the front window and the lens absorbs wavy heat lines. No people.
shots.narration: 房水主要是水，能吸收热量。

shots.scene: 晶状体变厚变薄，分别对准近处和远处
shots.prompt_en: The lens illustration changes from thick to thin, focusing on a near flower and then a far mountain. No people.
shots.narration: 晶状体能变形，远近都能看清。

shots.scene: 彩色的虹膜围着黑色的瞳孔
shots.prompt_en: A close-up illustration of a colored iris around a dark pupil. No people.
shots.narration: 虹膜像光圈，调节进光的多少。

shots.scene: 亮处瞳孔小，暗处瞳孔大
shots.prompt_en: Two eye illustrations: a small pupil under a sun icon, and a large pupil under a moon icon. No people.
shots.narration: 亮处瞳孔缩小，暗处瞳孔放大。

shots.scene: 暗室里放大的瞳孔前有一道光束，警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A large dilated pupil in a dim room with a thin beam approaching, and a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 暗室里瞳孔大，进眼的光也更多。

shots.scene: 眼球中央的透明凝胶被高亮
shots.prompt_en: The eyeball illustration with the clear gel in the center highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃体是透明凝胶，撑起眼球。

shots.scene: 眼底一层感光膜，像一块小屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The back of the eye drawn as a small curved screen with tiny rod and cone shapes. No people.
shots.narration: 视网膜像一块屏幕，把光变成电信号。

shots.scene: 视网膜正中一个小点被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A tiny spot at the center of the back of the eye glows as the most sensitive point. No people.
shots.narration: 中央凹最敏感，管最精细的视力。

shots.scene: 中央凹上的小点被红叉标出
shots.prompt_en: The tiny central spot is marked with a red damage icon. No people.
shots.narration: 激光伤到中央凹，是视力最坏的结局。

shots.section_title: 不同波长伤眼的部位不同
shots.scene: 彩虹色波长尺下方是眼球剖面
shots.prompt_en: A rainbow wavelength bar above an eyeball cross-section, with violet on the left and dark red on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 不同波长的光，伤眼的部位不同。
overlay: 不同波长伤眼的部位不同

shots.section_title: 不同波长伤眼的部位不同
shots.scene: 紫色射线停在眼睛最前面
shots.prompt_en: Violet rays stop at the clear front window of the eye. No people.
shots.narration: 短波紫外主要被角膜吸收。

shots.section_title: 不同波长伤眼的部位不同
shots.scene: 淡紫色射线穿过角膜，停在晶状体
shots.prompt_en: Pale violet rays pass the front window and stop in the lens. No people.
shots.narration: 长波紫外主要被晶状体吸收。

shots.section_title: 不同波长伤眼的部位不同
shots.scene: 可见光和暗红射线一直穿到眼底
shots.prompt_en: Colored visible rays and dark red rays pass all the way through to the back of the eye. No people.
shots.narration: 可见光和近红外，一直射到视网膜。

shots.section_title: 不同波长伤眼的部位不同
shots.scene: 眼底被高亮，警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The back of the eye highlighted with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 再被聚焦放大，所以最危险。

shots.section_title: 不同波长伤眼的部位不同
shots.scene: 欣欣摆手，旁边是紫色射线和眼睛前部发红图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head beside an icon of violet rays and a reddened front of an eye.
shots.narration: 紫外也会伤角膜和晶状体，不能大意。

shots.scene: 皮肤剖面示意：上层薄、下层厚
shots.prompt_en: A simple cross-section illustration of skin with a thin top layer and a thicker layer beneath. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤的风险排在眼睛之后。

shots.scene: 热浪图标和化学分子图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: wavy heat lines and a simple molecule shape. No people.
shots.narration: 光伤皮肤，有热的，也有光化学的。

shots.scene: 表皮、真皮两层标出，最外面一层干燥的死细胞
shots.prompt_en: The skin illustration with its outer dead cell layer, the epidermis and the dermis clearly separated. No people.
shots.narration: 表皮在上，真皮在下，最外是角质层。

shots.scene: 表皮中的深色小颗粒挡住紫色射线
shots.prompt_en: Small dark granules in the top skin layer catch violet rays before they go deeper. No people.
shots.narration: 黑色素吸收紫外，保护下面的真皮。

shots.scene: 可见光和红光被皮肤表面反射，紫色光被吸收
shots.prompt_en: Visible and red rays bounce off the skin surface while violet rays are absorbed into it. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤反射大部分可见光和近红外。

shots.scene: 紫色射线停在皮肤表层
shots.prompt_en: Violet rays absorbed in the top skin layer, which turns slightly red. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外容易被皮肤吸收，最需提防。

shots.scene: 很强很久的光束穿透到皮肤深层
shots.prompt_en: A strong beam with a clock icon pushes deep into the skin cross-section. No people.
shots.narration: 光够强、照够久，任何波长都能伤深层。

shots.scene: 日历翻页和皮肤老化图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with many pages flipping and an icon of wrinkled skin with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 长期受紫外照射，加速老化、易致癌。

shots.scene: 一台远红外激光器的光束让皮肤冒热浪
shots.prompt_en: A box-shaped far-infrared laser beam icon hitting skin with heat lines rising. No people.
shots.narration: 远红外激光，对皮肤的热伤害最明显。

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外、红外光源的防护
shots.scene: 欣欣戴上防紫外面罩，旁边一盏紫外灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot puts on a clear face shield beside a glowing ultraviolet lamp on a bench.
shots.narration: 强光、紫外、红外光源，都要防护。
overlay: 强光、紫外、红外光源的防护

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外、红外光源的防护
shots.scene: 小研戴防紫外护目镜，穿长袖实验服和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears ultraviolet-blocking goggles, a long-sleeved lab coat and gloves at a bench.
shots.narration: 用紫外灯，戴防紫外眼镜和面罩，遮住皮肤。

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外、红外光源的防护
shots.scene: 灯外罩着遮光罩和挡板
shots.prompt_en: A bright lamp enclosed in a dark housing with a black shield panel in front. No people.
shots.narration: 光源装好遮光罩，加挡板。

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外、红外光源的防护
shots.scene: 眼睛直视亮灯的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an eye staring straight at a bright arc lamp, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不直视弧光灯、闪光灯和强光源。

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外、红外光源的防护
shots.scene: 紫外灯旁的空白警示牌
shots.prompt_en: A blank warning placard with a sun-ray pictogram posted beside an ultraviolet lamp, and a general warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外灯工作时贴警示，离开就关灯。

shots.section_title: 灯具高温：防烫、远离易燃物
shots.scene: 阿杰戴隔热手套，等灯冷却后才更换
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waits with heat-resistant gloves on, then changes a cooled halogen bulb.
shots.narration: 换灯先断电，等灯冷却再动手。
overlay: 灯具高温：防烫、远离易燃物

shots.section_title: 灯具高温：防烫、远离易燃物
shots.scene: 手指碰石英灯壳的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of bare fingers touching a quartz bulb, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别用手指直接碰石英灯壳。

shots.section_title: 灯具高温：防烫、远离易燃物
shots.scene: 热灯旁的纸张和溶剂瓶被移开
shots.prompt_en: Paper sheets and a blank solvent bottle are moved away from a hot lamp, with arrows showing the clearance. No people.
shots.narration: 高温灯具周围，不放纸张和溶剂。

shots.scene: 闪光灯电源盒上的触电警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A blank power supply box for a flash lamp with an electric shock warning sign on its cover. No people.
shots.narration: 闪光灯、弧光灯电源电压很高。

shots.scene: 电源盒里的电容图标仍有闪电符号
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of the power box showing capacitor shapes still holding a lightning bolt after the plug is pulled. No people.
shots.narration: 断电后，电容里还可能存着电。

shots.scene: 老李挂上空白停电牌，等待电容放完电
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hangs a blank lockout tag on the switched-off power supply and waits beside it with insulated gloves.
shots.narration: 维修由授权人员断电、放电后进行。

shots.scene: 学生拆电源外壳的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student opening a power supply cover with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 学生不得自行拆开高压电源。

shots.section_title: 灯管破碎：汞与玻璃碎片
shots.scene: 地上一根摔碎的荧光灯管
shots.prompt_en: A broken fluorescent tube lying on the lab floor with glass fragments around it. No people.
shots.narration: 荧光灯和放电灯里含汞。
overlay: 灯管破碎：汞与玻璃碎片

shots.section_title: 灯管破碎：汞与玻璃碎片
shots.scene: 打开的窗户，人员离开房间的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An open window with airflow arrows and an arrow showing people leaving the room. No people.
shots.narration: 灯管破了，先开窗通风，人员暂离。

shots.section_title: 灯管破碎：汞与玻璃碎片
shots.scene: 小研戴手套，用硬纸片收集碎片装进密封袋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing gloves scoops glass fragments with stiff cardboard into a sealable bag.
shots.narration: 戴手套用硬纸收集，不用吸尘器。

shots.section_title: 灯管破碎：汞与玻璃碎片
shots.scene: 密封袋放进空白标签的废物桶
shots.prompt_en: A sealed bag placed into a waste bin with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 废灯管和碎片按含汞废物交回收。

shots.section_title: 眼睛受照后：报告与就医
shots.scene: 阿杰揉着发红的眼睛
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rubs his reddened eyes at the bench, looking uncomfortable.
shots.narration: 眼睛被强光、紫外照到，别硬撑。
overlay: 眼睛受照后：报告与就医

shots.section_title: 眼睛受照后：报告与就医
shots.scene: 揉眼的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of hands rubbing an eye, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要揉眼，立即停止工作。

shots.section_title: 眼睛受照后：报告与就医
shots.scene: 阿杰向王老师报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the safety administrator in the lab corridor.
shots.narration: 马上报告实验室负责人。

shots.section_title: 眼睛受照后：报告与就医
shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 及时就医，紧急时拨打120。

shots.section_title: 眼睛受照后：报告与就医
shots.scene: 王老师在空白记录本上登记
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes in a blank incident logbook with the young male student beside him.
shots.narration: 如实记录，查找原因，防止再犯。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验台旁，台上灯泡、灯管、LED 依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at an optical table as a bulb, a tube and an LED light up one by one.
shots.narration: 做光学实验，先要有光源。

shots.scene: 眼睛和皮肤图标旁一个激光器图标
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon and a skin icon next to a small laser box icon with a beam. No people.
shots.narration: 下一课，我们讲激光安全。

shots.scene: 白炽灯、荧光灯、放电灯、闪光灯、LED 五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: a light bulb, a fluorescent tube, a discharge lamp, a flash tube and an LED. No people.
shots.narration: 五类光源，原理各不相同。

shots.scene: 热浪、闪电、紫色射线三个警示图标
shots.prompt_en: Three warning icons: heat lines, a lightning bolt and violet rays. No people.
shots.narration: 高温、高压、紫外，是它们的隐患。

shots.scene: 放大镜聚焦到眼底的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lens focusing light into a tiny bright dot at the back of an eye. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睛会聚光，杂散光束最危险。

shots.scene: 护目镜、面罩、手套三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: goggles, a face shield and gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睛皮肤都要护，出了事先报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着护目镜挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears safety goggles and waves goodbye at the camera beside a tidy optical table.
shots.narration: 认识光，善用光，下次见！
